A '''card scanner''' was used by an [[Air taxi/Legends|air taxi]] [[Pilot/Legends|driver]] [[Unidentified air taxi driver droid|droid]]<ref name="Deceived" /> in [[3653 BBY]]<ref name="TEA">Page 134 of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' states that the [[Great Galactic War]] ended in this date.</ref> to get payment for his taxi fare. Rogue [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Aryn Leneer]] had to pay with one of these card scanners after being taken to the [[Eeseen spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="Deceived" />
